program.step:
if data.time < state.quiet_until:
    return
red = model.body('red_ball').id
blue = model.body('blue_ball').id
rj = model.body_jntadr[red]
bj = model.body_jntadr[blue]
rq = model.jnt_qposadr[rj]
bq = model.jnt_qposadr[bj]
dx = float(data.qpos[rq] - data.qpos[bq])
dy = float(data.qpos[rq + 1] - data.qpos[bq + 1])
distance = math.hypot(dx, dy)
if distance == 0.0:
    return
accel = state.acceleration * np.array([dx / distance, dy / distance, 0.0])
data.xfrc_applied[red, :3] += float(model.body_mass[red]) * accel
data.xfrc_applied[blue, :3] += -float(model.body_mass[blue]) * accel
